prev_agent: Because the padding was the same, but the content inside the header was not. Open tree: preview header contains only the filename text, so height is roughly `16px line-height + 12px + 12px`. Closed tree: preview header also contained the 36x36 “Show file tree” button in normal flex flow, so the row became `36px button + 12px + 12px`. That made it look like the header padding changed.
